mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", cost_id AS "costId", ability_id AS "abilityId", phase_id AS "phaseId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", amount_formula_key AS "amountFormulaKey", allow_partial AS "allowPartial", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_costs WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND cost_id = #{costId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.ability_costs (game_id, cost_id, ability_id, phase_id, resource_key, amount_formula_key, allow_partial, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{costId}, #{abilityId}, #{phaseId}, #{resourceKey}, #{amountFormulaKey}, #{allowPartial}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, cost_id) DO UPDATE SET ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, phase_id = EXCLUDED.phase_id, resource_key = EXCLUDED.resource_key, amount_formula_key = EXCLUDED.amount_formula_key, allow_partial = EXCLUDED.allow_partial, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", cost_id AS "costId", ability_id AS "abilityId", phase_id AS "phaseId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", amount_formula_key AS "amountFormulaKey", allow_partial AS "allowPartial", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.ability_costs WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, cost_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.ability_costs_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, cost_id, ability_id, phase_id, resource_key, amount_formula_key, allow_partial ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, cost_id, ability_id, phase_id, resource_key, amount_formula_key, allow_partial FROM public.ability_costs WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, cost_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, ability_id = EXCLUDED.ability_id, phase_id = EXCLUDED.phase_id, resource_key = EXCLUDED.resource_key, amount_formula_key = EXCLUDED.amount_formula_key, allow_partial = EXCLUDED.allow_partial
